meaning.zh:
“吐露心声” 或 “倾吐心事”。

这个短语起源于人们某些时候感到心里压抑和沉重的想法或者情感，就像是一种负担压在胸口。当一个人把这些压在心里的事情说出来时，这个人就会感到一种释放和轻松。“Get it off my chest” 意为将这些隐瞒的话或情感吐露出来，使自己心情舒畅。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from the feeling of having a heavy burden or repressed emotions weighing on one's chest. When someone speaks out these hidden thoughts or feelings, they experience a sense of release and relief. "Get it off my chest" means to reveal these withheld thoughts or emotions to make oneself feel better.

lines.en: I need to get it off my chest and tell you how I really feel.
lines.zh: 我需要倾诉心声，告诉你我真正的感受。

lines.en: She finally got it off her chest and confessed her mistake.
lines.zh: 她终于吐露心事，承认了自己的错误。

lines.en: It was a relief to get it off my chest and talk about my problems.
lines.zh: 把心中的烦恼说出来真是一种解脱。
